message.content:
An orange magazine cover titled "TEMPO" in large brown letters features a central illustration of a gavel-shaped mass. This mass is composed of numerous small, white-clad human figures crowded together. The handle of the gavel extends diagonally from the lower left towards the upper right, where the head of the gavel is formed by a larger cluster of figures. Scattered around this central shape are individual figures, some holding small flags or placards, casting long shadows to the left on the orange background.

Text at the top reads "AKHIR HIDUP INTAN OLIVIA" and "BANDANG DI BANDUNG". Below the main title "MENOHOK AHOK" in bold white letters, smaller black text states: "TARIK-ULUR PENETAPAN SANG CALON GUBERNUR INKUMBEN SEBAGAI TERSANGKA PENISTA AGAMA, ELEKTABILITASNYA DIPERKIRAKAN MEROSOT." A red vertical bar borders the left side. The bottom right includes the date "21-27 NOVEMBER 2016", the price "RP 45.000", a website, and a barcode. A small, multicolored logo sits above the word "TEMPO". All elements are set against a solid orange field.
